items.finding: packs/* has a row in the dependency table but lives outside packages/, so an @falens edge added to packs/package.json would go unchecked.
items.fix: answered: recorded in Progress. Packs are data by ADR-0010 and carry no code, and the pack validator already refuses a script file there; if packs ever gains a manifest edge this is worth a unit

items.finding: optionalDependencies and peerDependencies were not read, so an edge declared under either would be invisible.
items.fix: fixed: all four dependency fields are read, with a selftest case proving an optional and a peer edge are both flagged

summary: The manifest and test-walk extensions correctly enforce ADR-0001's one-way dependency table with zero new dependencies, no loosened assertions, and no files outside allowed_files.
